title: MP Samagra (Family ID) Now on DigiLocker: 9.5 Crore Residents Get Instant Digital Access
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Electronics & IT

MP Samagra (Family ID) Now on DigiLocker: 9.5 Crore Residents Get Instant Digital Access

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
17 JUN 2026 2:25PM by PIB Delhi

Around 9.5 crore residents of Madhya Pradesh can now access their MP Samagra (Family ID) on DigiLocker. India’s flagship digital document wallet under the Digital India programme has on-boarded the credential issued by the Government of Madhya Pradesh, putting a verified copy within every citizen’s reach.

The integration works in both directions. Citizens can pull their existing MP Samagra (Family ID) into DigiLocker for faster access to government services and welfare schemes, and — because DigiLocker is also connected to Samagra as a requestor — they can enrol for a new Family ID digitally and give consent from within the app.

Citizens can access their MP Samagra (Family ID) on DigiLocker in four simple steps:

1. Open the DigiLocker app or visit digilocker.gov.in and sign in.

2. Go to “Issued Documents” or search “Samagra / Family ID Madhya Pradesh.”

3. Enter the required details and give consent.

4. Fetch the document — it is saved instantly to your DigiLocker account.

By bringing the Samagra (Family ID) onto DigiLocker, Madhya Pradesh advances its vision of a paperless, efficient and digitally empowered governance ecosystem — with the credential now available anytime, anywhere.

“The Samagra ID underpins welfare delivery across Madhya Pradesh; on DigiLocker it is now always within reach, secure and verified,”

Key Benefits for Citizens

• Convenient retrieval of the Family ID for availing government services and welfare schemes

•  Reduced dependence on physical documents and paper-based processes

• Provides access to various public services, including welfare benefits, Direct Benefit Transfers (DBTs) and social security initiatives

• MP Samagra (Family ID) is a legally valid digital credential issued by the source authority.

• Faster and more convenient verification for government schemes and services until fulfilment.

• Enhanced accessibility for citizens and improves the digital literacy across urban and rural areas of the state.

The initiative reflects the shared commitment of the Government of Madhya Pradesh and DigiLocker to leverage technology for improving citizen convenience, service delivery and digital inclusion.

As DigiLocker continues to expand its ecosystem of trusted digital credentials, initiatives such as this will help strengthen the vision of Digital India by making government-issued documents more accessible, secure and convenient for every citizen.

About DigiLocker

DigiLocker is the Government of India’s flagship platform for the issuance and verification of documents and certificates in digital form, under the Digital India programme. It gives every citizen a secure, cloud-based account to access authentic digital documents anytime, anywhere, removing the need to carry physical copies.



About DigiLocker

DigiLocker is the Government of India’s flagship platform for issuing and verifying documents and certificates in digital form, under the Digital India programme. It gives every citizen a secure, cloud-based account to access authentic digital documents anytime, anywhere, removing the need to carry physical copies.
